---
title: "Voles metabolism trial: interim summary"
date: 2026-10-19
format: html
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("scripts", "functions", "load_voles.R"))

voles_df <- load_voles() |>
  mutate(treatment_arm = factor(treatment_arm,
                                levels = c("Control", "Low_dose", "High_dose")))
fit <- lm(mass_post_g ~ mass_pre_g + treatment_arm + sex, data = voles_df)
ci <- confint(fit)["treatment_armHigh_dose", ]
primary <- tibble(
  estimate = unname(coef(fit)["treatment_armHigh_dose"]),
  lower = unname(ci[1]),
  upper = unname(ci[2])
)
n_animals <- nrow(voles_df)
```

## Methods

We weighed `r n_animals` voles before and after treatment, 12 in each
combination of treatment arm and sex.

## Results

High-dose voles were `r round(primary$estimate, 2)` g heavier than controls
after treatment (95% CI `r round(primary$lower, 2)` to
`r round(primary$upper, 2)` g), adjusting for pre-treatment mass and sex.

In an earlier draft the difference was 1.53 g (95% CI 0.94 to 2.12 g), and
the mean post-treatment mass across all animals was 29.4 g.
